items.headline: Appalachian State hands James Madison first loss of season
items.description: James London kicked a 40-yard field goal in overtime to give Appalachian State the win Thursday night and leave just five unbeaten teams in the FBS.

items.headline: James London's 40-yard FG in OT helps Appalachian St. beat James Madison 34-31
items.description: — James London kicked a walk-off 40-yard field goal in overtime, Malachi Singleton threw two touchdown passes, and Appalachian State beat previously-unbeaten James Madison 34-31 on Thursday night.
